Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: In Step 3, the Planner incorrectly deduced that Edward de Vere's paternal grandfather was John de Vere, 14th Earl of Oxford. The logic used was that the 17th Earl is two generations after the 15th, so the grandfather must be the 14th Earl. However, the title "Earl of Oxford" is hereditary; each generation holds the title of the next ordinal number (15th Earl -> 16th Earl -> 17th Earl). Therefore, the father of the 16th Earl (who is the grandfather of the 17th Earl) is the **15th Earl**, not the 14th. The 14th Earl would be the great-grandfather. This fundamental error in genealogical ordinal logic was made by the Planner, leading the subsequent WebSurfer searches to look for the wrong person for several turns.
